title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco State University on 1966-10-02

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a quirky Acid Test show featuring creepy, psychedelic “prankster” collages; the performance is praised for its dark humor and experimental edge.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers enjoyed this recording, noting the unusual, almost techno‑ish sound collage sections and haunting piano that give the set a distinctive, eerie vibe. The soundboard source is described as clear enough to appreciate these oddities, making it a worthwhile listen despite the show’s experimental nature.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments about the show’s uniqueness and solid musical moments combined with a clean soundboard source yield an overall high rating, but limited detail on technical quality lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers imply the recording is clear enough to hear the experimental collages and piano sections.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An experimental, dark‑psychedelic flow with quirky sound‑collage interludes that give the concert a creepy, off‑beat character.
